title: DoT Selects Three Sanchar Mitras as ITU Generation Connect Youth Envoys
summary: Department of Telecommunications selected 3 Indian Sanchar Mitras as ITU Generation Connect Youth Envoys (GCYE).

blocks.content: Department of Telecommunications selected 3 Indian Sanchar Mitras as ITU Generation Connect Youth Envoys (GCYE).

items: **Selected Envoys:** (1) Ankit Kumar Pal, (2) Manish Kumar Mandal, (3) Susmita Sain.
**Sanchar Mitra Role:** Engages youth in telecom awareness, digital safety, and telecom fraud prevention.
